title: A Field That Moves With the Vehicle: Protective Fields Sized by Stopping Distance, Bent Round the Turn, and Switched in Sets

artifact.note: protective fields for a ground vehicle, in the manner of the fields of a safety laser scanner (as used under the standard for driverless industrial trucks, ISO 3691-4, which this lesson models but does not claim to meet): a stop field as long as the stopping distance at the speed plus a margin, as wide as the vehicle plus a margin, bent along the arc of the turn; a warning field twice as long; points in the vehicle frame tested against them; and the choice of the smallest of a few field sets that was designed for at least the speed
